statement: Linux identifies DualSense Edge using separate Sony product PID 0x0df2 and sets is_edge, enabling dedicated Fn/paddle input controls; SDL identifies the Edge by Sony product ID and presents an Edge-specific device name/type/extended buttons. The base DualSense PID 0x0ce6 remains a distinct controller; these device identities belong to the registry controller `dualsense-edge`, never silently merged into `dualsense`.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b/829a65d, HHD adbd50f and community pinned commits; physical firmware unknown
applicability.scope: Linux hid-playstation.c 1796-1835, 2950-2958; SDL 535d80b 524-533 and 829a65d 442-446; HHD 133-150. Both source paths are consumers or emulated identity; no physical Edge hardware validation.
